expectations.criterion: sets and restores explicit logical viewport and pixel-ratio test state using APIs compatible with the project SDK
expectations.evidence: Explicitly sets devicePixelRatio to 1 and physicalSize to the logical case size, and registers view.reset for teardown. However, it does not verify project SDK compatibility for tester.view, FakeViewPadding, or TextScaler.

expectations.criterion: uses deterministic named fixtures and a bounded risk-based combination matrix rather than device names or a full Cartesian product
expectations.evidence: Defines named fixture enums and eight explicit cases, distributing typical content across widths and concentrating stress combinations at compact width, with one deliberate combined-stress case. Explicitly requires deterministic harness fixtures.

expectations.criterion: checks relevant overflow geometry containment scrolling and hit-test behavior and separates widget-test evidence from golden or real-device evidence
expectations.evidence: Checks framework exceptions, field and Save containment, field/action non-overlap, scrolling with ensureVisible, Save hit-testability, and a submit callback after tapping. Explicitly identifies these as widget-level checks with simulated keyboard insets and reserves real OS keyboard verification for device tests.

judgment.summary: Provides a bounded, maintainable matrix with concrete geometry and interaction assertions, but does not explicitly establish compatibility with the project SDK.
